# function: endpoint_auth

Builds the EndpointAuth message from an object and returns its protojson encoding, the value `authwise_endpoint.auth` takes: the same string `data.authwise_endpoint_auth` exposes as `json` for the same arguments, with the same attributes and checks. Requires Terraform 1.8 or later.

Use it in place of the data source to keep plans quiet. Terraform reads a data source at apply whenever a resource named in its arguments has a change planned, so `authwise_endpoint.auth` plans an update that applies as a no-op; this function is evaluated at plan whenever its argument is known.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Exactly one of bearer, basic, header and kit_token.
resource "authwise_endpoint" "this" {
  display_name = "Risk service"
  address      = "https://risk.example.com/v1"
  auth = provider::authwise::endpoint_auth({
    bearer = {
      token = { name = authwise_secret.risk_token.name }
    }
  })
}
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
endpoint_auth(config dynamic) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `config` (Dynamic) An object with the attributes of `data.authwise_endpoint_auth`, snake_case as there. Unset attributes are left out.
